name: Wildmane Totem
summary: At the Wildmane Well, Mull Thunderhorn seeks to heal Mulgore's last poisoned waters. He needs prairie wolf alpha teeth for a totem that can cleanse them.

sections.title: The Final Well
sections.body: The Wildmane Well is the last poisoned source in central Mulgore. Mull Thunderhorn has gathered what he needs for the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells, yet poisoned water still harms migrating wildlife and settlements across the plains. Powerful ingredients from the land are needed to restore its balance.

sections.title: The Predator's Strength
sections.body: Prairie wolf alphas roam Mulgore's grasslands, especially beneath the high bluffs below Thunder Bluff. Mull Thunderhorn needs their teeth for a cleansing totem meant for the northern waters. Their strength and endurance will lend the totem the power of these fierce hunters.

sections.title: Sacrifice and Balance
sections.body: For tauren, taking from the land's creatures carries solemn weight. Mull Thunderhorn sees the alpha teeth as a necessity, not a conquest. The predators' sacrifice may help heal the Earth Mother's poisoned waters.

faq.q: What is the Wildmane Totem needed for?
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn makes the totem to cleanse the Wildmane Well, the last contaminated source threatening Mulgore's tauren.

faq.q: Why are prairie wolf alpha teeth specifically required?
faq.answer: The Wildmane Well's deep corruption calls for the fierce strength of an apex predator. Alpha teeth bring that primal force into the totem.

faq.q: Where are prairie wolf alphas found in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Prairie wolf alphas roam Mulgore's northern plains, especially in the grasslands around the base of Thunder Bluff.
Mull Thunderhorn, a spiritual elder in Bloodhoof Village, makes each cleansing totem after an initiate gathers the offerings.

faq.q: What follows the crafting of the Wildmane Totem?
faq.answer: After Mull Thunderhorn makes a totem from the alpha teeth, you carry it north to purify the Wildmane Well.

faq.q: How does this ritual reflect tauren beliefs?
faq.answer: Tauren treat taking an animal's life as a solemn exchange with nature. Mull grieves the wolves' deaths and honors their part in healing the earth.

angles.text: As a tauren, you inherit a duty to heal the ancestral wells and honor what the Earth Mother asks the land to give.
As a shaman, you know the care needed to bring predator totems and elemental water into harmony against toxic blight.
As a hunter, you test your respect for the wilderness and its fiercest predators as you track cunning alpha wolves around the high bluffs.
